transcript.content: COD order ka refund kaise milta hai bhai?

Bhai, COD order ke liye refund bank transfer (NEFT/IMPS) ke through milta hai. Ek specialist aapko ek secure link email ya SMS se bhejta hai jisme aapke bank account aur IFSC details daalne ke liye hai. Aapki safety ke liye kisi bhi chat mein bank details nahi de sakte. Refund 7 business days mein hoga jab details verify honge. Agar aapko koi aur help chahiye, toh bataiye!
